cross_format.role: JSON health map — embedded data consumed by Go health scoring system.
cross_format.toml_counterpart: none — health maps are JSON-native (embedded via Go embed.FS, parsed at init)
cross_format.relationship: JSON defines health scoring DATA (operation weights, multipliers). TOML would define health CONFIGURATION if needed. This is data, not config.

_M_extension_note.extension: M6+ available for domain-specific metadata in derived files
_M_extension_note.rule: M1-M5 are the base contract. Health map files extend with M6_operational for runtime behavior.

_M6_operational.health: Base100 | granted (1): all ops mapped | deferred (0): some missing | denied (-1): parse error

on_error.invalid_score: Fall back to CRUD base score

crud_meaning.C: Create — bringing new existence (+1 success, cascade on fail)
crud_meaning.R: Read — understanding what exists (+1 success, minimal cascade)
crud_meaning.U: Update — transforming toward new state (+1 success, medium cascade)
crud_meaning.D: Delete — removing existence, irreversible (+1 success, severe cascade)

_M7_paradigm.scoring_flow: operation -> CRUD type -> base score -> cascade multiplier -> health impact

_Cc_format_note: JSON strict — no comments, no trailing commas, UTF-8, LF line endings.
_Cc_key_convention: lowercase_with_underscores for data keys, _prefix for documentation fields
_Cc_constraint: Every operation must have crud field (C, R, U, or D)
_Cv_expected_state: Valid JSON with crud_base, operations, and cascade_multipliers present.
_closing_structure: X.1 Policy → X.2 Extension → X.3 Troubleshooting → X.4 Reference → X.5 Note
_X1_scripture: Remove not the ancient landmark, which thy fathers have set. — Proverbs 22:28
_X1_never: Modify crud_base without understanding downstream impact
Remove required _ fields without updating the schema
_X1_careful: Change CRUD mappings (affects all health scores)
Adding new M sections (requires schema version bump)
_X1_safe: Adjust health notes and _ documentation fields

_X3_problems.missing_crud: Every operation must have crud field with C, R, U, or D
_X3_problems.invalid_cascade: cascade_override must be: hardware, filesystem, memory, readonly, default
_X3_problems.duplicate_op: Each operation name must be unique within map
_X3_problems.type_mismatch: Verify consumer struct tags match JSON keys. Go uses json.Unmarshal tags.
